title: Microsoft Purview: new Data Security Posture Management experience with objectives, AI observability and agents
notes: claim 64: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: assigning a DSPM role group does not govern everything in the experience, as the briefing claims; Microsoft requires additional roles for several activities. The published controls and roadmap facts are otherwise supported, with smaller corrections needed to the licensing wording and governance checklist.
